scripts.dev: npm run build:shared && concurrently -n web,api -c auto "npm run dev -w @stride/web" "npm run dev -w @stride/api"
scripts.build: npm run build:shared && npm run build -w @stride/api -w @stride/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run build:shared && npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present
scripts.test: npm run build:shared && npm run test --workspaces --if-present
scripts.test:e2e: npm run build:shared && npm run test:e2e -w apps/web
